pages.title: Lego Ninjago Lloyd Green Ninja Coloring Page
pages.description: Lloyd, the Green Ninja, holds a sword in this Lego Ninjago printable coloring page, standing beside bamboo beneath curled cloud shapes with his eyes visible above the mask. A dragon-head emblem joins crossed torso straps. The tied sash, patterned handle, broad blade, and block-shaped feet offer a range of clearly enclosed sections.

pages.title: Lego Ninjago Lloyd Golden Ninja Coloring Page
pages.description: Lloyd appears as the Golden Ninja in this Lego Ninjago printable coloring page, wearing a crested mask and shoulder armor with crossed sword handles behind his head. Round chest ornaments and angular uniform details flank the wrap-front neckline. Simple wall panels and floor lines frame the figure's broad legs and knotted sash.

pages.title: Lego Ninjago Lloyd Garmadon Coloring Page
pages.description: Lloyd Garmadon stands before a sweeping energy shape in this Lego Ninjago printable coloring page, wearing a crested hood, folded mask, and segmented shoulder guards over his uniform. His curved hands hang beside a tied sash. Thick outlines and broad sleeves, torso panels, and rectangular legs keep the central minifigure clearly defined.

pages.title: Lego Ninjago Lloyd with Sword Coloring Page
pages.description: Lloyd holds a sword diagonally across his body in this Lego Ninjago printable coloring page, standing before a simple gateway with focused eyes above his wrapped mask. The long blade crosses the foreground from its patterned handle and angular guard. His open curved hand, uniform neckline, and knotted sash provide smaller details below.

pages.title: Lego Ninjago Lloyd Using Green Energy Powers Coloring Page
pages.description: Lloyd uses green energy powers in this Lego Ninjago printable coloring page, raising both hands inside curling circular energy shapes that frame his masked figure. Long jagged streaks extend across the background. The plain wrap-front uniform, tied sash, curved arms, and block feet contrast with the layered edges of the energy effects.

pages.title: Lego Ninjago Lloyd Green Ninja Zx Coloring Page
pages.description: Lloyd wears his Green Ninja ZX armor in this Lego Ninjago printable coloring page, holding a curved sword across the foreground beneath a crested mask and shoulder guards. Two tied bands cross the front of his uniform at different heights. Thick contours and an open background emphasize the full minifigure and broad blade.

pages.title: Lego Ninjago Lloyd Performing Spinjitzu Coloring Page
pages.description: Lloyd performs Spinjitzu in this Lego Ninjago printable coloring page, spreading his arms while a large tapering whirlwind wraps around his lower body in sweeping rings. His masked face and decorated uniform remain visible above the widest band. Long curved ribbons and a pointed vortex base create a strong spiral shape across the page.

pages.title: Lego Ninjago Lloyd and Garmadon Coloring Page
pages.description: Lloyd and Garmadon stand side by side in this Lego Ninjago printable coloring page, with Lloyd's uncovered hair beside Garmadon's large crested helmet and chest armor. Both minifigures wear tied sashes and hold their hands at their sides. A simple gateway and mountain outline frame the pair without crowding the character details.

pages.title: Lego Ninjago Lloyd with Dragon Coloring Page
pages.description: Lloyd stands with a dragon in this Lego Ninjago printable coloring page, smiling beside a friendly upright creature with a block-shaped head, small wings, and a banded chest. The dragon has minifigure-style hands and feet, with a tail curling behind it. Clouds and grass tufts frame Lloyd's simple uniform and tied sash.

pages.title: Lego Ninjago Movie Lloyd Coloring Page
pages.description: Lloyd from The Lego Ninjago Movie smiles in this printable coloring page, with his face visible above a lowered wrap and beneath a rounded head covering. A wrap-front uniform and rectangular belt buckle define the torso. Thick outlines, large hands, and simple clouds and brick shapes create open sections around the close character portrait.

pages.title: Lego Ninjago Lloyd in Shintaro Palace Coloring Page
pages.description: Lloyd stands before Shintaro Palace in this Lego Ninjago printable coloring page, wearing shoulder armor and a dragon-decorated uniform above wrapped legs and a knotted sash. Ornate balconies, pointed towers, curved roofs, and a patterned doorway fill the background. Broad steps and cracked paving lead toward the detailed palace behind the central figure.

pages.title: Lego Ninjago Lloyd in Monastery Courtyard Coloring Page
pages.description: Lloyd holds a sword in a monastery courtyard in this Lego Ninjago printable coloring page, facing forward beneath a hood and segmented guards above his shoulders. Dragon motifs decorate his armor and long upright blade. Blossoming branches, a small lantern, a tiled roof, and paneled doors provide smaller details around the ninja.

pages.title: Lego Ninjago Lloyd in Never Realm Coloring Page
pages.description: Lloyd stands in the Never Realm in this Lego Ninjago printable coloring page, clasping a sword handle between both hands beneath snowflake-decorated shoulder pieces and a dragon-marked hood. Ice crystals and snowflakes float around the figure beside a frozen cliff. Jagged costume patterns and an ornate belt add detail to the wintry portrait.

pages.title: Lego Ninjago Lloyd in Royal Blacksmith Shop Coloring Page
pages.description: Lloyd visits the Royal Blacksmith Shop in this Lego Ninjago printable coloring page, holding a sword with his hair uncovered and one hand at his hip. An anvil, hammer, tool rack, shields, and spare blades fill the workshop. His shoulder armor and wrapped legs contrast with the finer masonry and equipment behind him.

pages.title: Lego Ninjago Lloyd in Merlopia Coloring Page
pages.description: Lloyd appears in Merlopia in this Lego Ninjago printable coloring page, wearing fin-shaped helmet details and scaled armor while holding two ornate underwater weapons across his body. Bubbles rise around the masked figure beside coral and seaweed. A forehead crest, wing-like shoulder pieces, chest gem shape, and broad cape add distinctive costume sections.
